claim_boundary: This zip does not claim live GPU proof; it provides the corrected probe and deterministic tests. Live proof must be generated on the target PersonaPlex machine.
fallback_policy: When the venv, server, CUDA, or generated output is unavailable, the probe writes real_gpu_personaplex=false and exits 0 unless --require-real is supplied.
purpose: Fix PersonaPlex P10 GPU probe to call personaplex_golden_state_server.py under the PersonaPlex venv with --probe-lmgen-step --json, rather than Docker REST or Moshi/Opus WebSocket.
real_proof_condition: p10-gpu-personaplex-receipt.json has real_gpu_personaplex=true, valid_cuda_device=true, valid_generated_output=true, returncode=0, and command includes --probe-lmgen-step --json
